response.description:
As part of
Azure’s ongoing security improvements, App Service, Functions, and Logic Apps
will no longer accept connections using TLS 1.0 or TLS 1.1 after May 31, 2027.
Any client, application, or service that continues to use these legacy TLS
versions will be unable to connect to these services after his date. Customers should
review the applications and services that connect to App Service, Functions, or
Logic Apps and ensure they support TLS 1.2 or later prior to this date. View the resources in your subscription that still allow TLS 1.0 or 1.1 in the Azure Retirement Workbook.Next steps Test client compatibility
with TLS 1.2 or later. Review the TLS
version deprecation overview for configuration guidance and see the service‑specific
Q&A links below for common questions. Learn more:
 App
     Service TLS deprecation Q&A  
 Functions
     TLS deprecation Q&A  
 Logic
     Apps TLS deprecation Q&A
response.title: Retirement:  TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 in Azure App Service, Azure Functions, and Azure Logic Apps
